objective: Refresh newly reported Perth detached-house sales for market trends
result: Build checks passed. Serving baseline captured. Chrome listing GraphQL endpoint verified with a complete 34-listing Hocking capture. Standalone curl POST still returns a challenge; no fresh listings ingested or published.

workspace.limits: The automated tests cover CSV parsing and CLI arguments, not live collection or database curation. Windows sandbox path-resolution failures were resolved by running the checks outside the sandbox. No local database environment or original archive is present here.

hosting.limits: The deployment listing establishes project status; its reported aliases do not establish which deployment owns the custom domain. Live database procedure definitions were not inspected.

servingBaseline.meaning: Snapshot of current public analytical responses, not a fresh source capture. July is a partial source month.

availableSourceArchive.reconciliationLimit: The missing historical file/row has not been identified. Raw source rows differ from unique observations and canonical sales.

augustSample.scope: Perth 6000, pages 1-2; not a market-wide refresh

availableSourceArchive.otherCheckoutLimit: The application under ToBeSorted/rea-for-all is now VIC House Data Lab. Do not reuse its estate defaults or database credentials for Perth. Only its immutable WA archive and extension helpers were used.

httpAccess.successfulEndpoint: POST https://lexa.realestate.com.au/graphql, soldSearchByQuery, HTTP 200 in Chrome for pages 1 and 2
httpAccess.freshBoundedCapture: hocking-listing-capture.json: 34 unique exact Hocking house listings, terminal pagination verified
httpAccess.standaloneEndpointPost: Plain curl of the observed request body returned 429 challenge HTML; browser anti-bot header values were not copied
httpAccess.soldSearch: Two unauthenticated curl requests returned 429 and challenge HTML, with no listing records.
httpAccess.listingExportApi: The documented listing export endpoint returned 401 without credentials.
httpAccess.officialScope: REA Listing Export requires authenticated, entitled agency/customer access. It is not anonymous market-wide search access.
httpAccess.nextAccessTest: Successful Chrome listing responses establish a browser-session source. Use their structured listing schema and explicit pagination for the new collector; unattended direct HTTP access remains unproven.
httpAccess.limits: These tests cover the named sold-search URLs and the documented Listing Export endpoint. They do not prove that every REA endpoint is inaccessible. No challenge-solving, proxy rotation or copied session-token replay was attempted.

findings.issue: Repeated content-script injection accumulates message listeners and can multiply page fetches
findings.action: Ensure a single listener per page before a broad extension run.

findings.issue: Page progress is checkpointed before extracted records are persisted; worker restart can skip an unfinished page
findings.action: Checkpoint the last successfully persisted page, and resume failed pages.

findings.issue: Missing cards can be interpreted as successful empty collection
findings.action: Distinguish confirmed end-of-results, source challenges, selector errors and capped windows; retain completion evidence per slice.

findings.issue: Known listings retain the original selected observation, so subsequent price disclosure and date corrections do not update current sales
findings.action: Select the best retained observation deterministically, with one stable current sale per listing. Do not change selection alone: the current price/date-dependent fingerprint could produce duplicate sales.

findings.issue: Listing observation_count is a per-file maximum rather than the cumulative raw history count
findings.action: Use retained raw observations when reporting capture history.

findings.issue: Price ranges can become numeric midpoints and enter price statistics
findings.action: Retain original price text and distinguish disclosed transaction prices from guides or inferred numeric values.

findings.issue: Reconciliation uses a fixed historical baseline; legitimate new observations increase those counts
findings.action: Validate each dated capture against its own manifest and explain changes at listing/sale grain.

findings.issue: Current workspace MotherDuck publication swaps tables without a transaction or retained analytical version
findings.action: Use an atomic publication and retain the previous dated baseline. The newer VIC checkout already has a transactional swap; no migration was performed here.

preparedRefresh.scope: WA houses, exact suburb, no bedroom/price restriction
preparedRefresh.limits: Prepared, not launched. Import does not apply plan settings or export destination. It is incompatible with the active workspace's older v1.0 popup. Applying exact-only scope to all locations changes the raw-query coverage of 28 historical jobs. Export/archive completed jobs before clearing them; v1.1 deduplicates slice identities independently of the run ID.

completedBoundedCapture.scope: Hocking WA 6065 houses, exact suburb, six-month window
completedBoundedCapture.validation: Existing source parser accepted all 34 rows and 17 columns; unique observation keys, expected scope, date ordering and artifact SHA-256 checks passed. Saved projected listing rows also match the browser extraction checksum.
completedBoundedCapture.limits: This capture establishes one suburb's result-window coverage, not a Perth-wide trend or a completed 358-suburb refresh. All rows are new observations; only 18 listing IDs are new to the retained archive.

completionCriteria: Demonstrate one successful source response with actual listing records.
Collect one bounded suburb sample and verify dates, listing IDs, price text, retry identity and completion reason.
Retain a dated capture manifest and per-slice coverage; mark capped or failed slices incomplete.
Validate new listings and overlapping observations without counting corrected versions as extra sales.
Reconcile and publish only to the verified WA estate, then verify served date coverage and sample sizes.
externalMutations: None: no ingestion, publication, deployment or recurring schedule was started.
